CREATE TABLE owner (
  "OwnerNo" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "FullName" TEXT NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT owner_pkey PRIMARY KEY ("OwnerNo")
);

CREATE TABLE pet (
  pet_no INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "Name" VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  "OwnerNo" INTEGER,
  CONSTRAINT pet_pkey PRIMARY KEY (pet_no),
  CONSTRAINT "pet_OwnerNo_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("OwnerNo") REFERENCES owner ("OwnerNo")
);

CREATE TABLE pet_bird (
  wing_span DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  "CanFly" BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  pet_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT pet_bird_pkey PRIMARY KEY (pet_no),
  CONSTRAINT pet_bird_pet_no_fkey FOREIGN KEY (pet_no) REFERENCES pet (pet_no) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE tank (
  "TankNo" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "Litres" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT tank_pkey PRIMARY KEY ("TankNo")
);

CREATE TABLE pet_fish (
  "Water" VARCHAR(30),
  pet_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  tank_no INTEGER,
  CONSTRAINT pet_fish_pkey PRIMARY KEY (pet_no),
  CONSTRAINT pet_fish_pet_no_fkey FOREIGN KEY (pet_no) REFERENCES pet (pet_no) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT pet_fish_tank_no_fkey FOREIGN KEY (tank_no) REFERENCES tank ("TankNo")
);
